collector_manifest_parent.name: collector_manifest_parent
collector_manifest_parent.value: ("collector_manifests"."kind" = 'candidates' AND "collector_manifests"."discovery_id" IS NOT NULL AND "collector_manifests"."generation_id" IS NULL) OR ("collector_manifests"."kind" IN ('chunks', 'results') AND "collector_manifests"."generation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "collector_manifests"."discovery_id" IS NULL)

collector_operation_lease.name: collector_operation_lease
collector_operation_lease.value: ("collector_operations"."status" = 'running' AND "collector_operations"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "collector_operations"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL) OR ("collector_operations"."status" <> 'running' AND "collector_operations"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "collector_operations"."lease_until" IS NULL)
